matrix_axes: Every explicit surface/hoist/search/semantic/backup/inspect/bash-enabled/background combination. No disabled_tools in rows; subtract the exact registered name for historical filtering. bash_background is effective resolved setting; when bash is false companions are absent.
v1_v2: OpenCode V1 buildOpenCodeToolMap and V2 registerAftTools project the same definition inventory.
pi_omp: OMP uses the Pi extension registration implementation; powershell_tool and live host PowerShell state are separately listed as conditional variants.

conditional_variants.pi_omp_powershell: If Pi host PowerShell is enabled (or config bash.powershell_tool fallback true), bash is enabled, and the selected host/prefixed powershell name is not disabled, add powershell when hoist true or aft_powershell when false, including on minimal; with bash.background true also add bash_status, bash_write, bash_watch, bash_kill. If bash also registered, companions are de-duplicated. PowerShell is host-dependent, not one of seven canonical host slots.
conditional_variants.hashline: Hashline request changes edit schema to patch only when both canonical read and edit hoisted registrations survive. Hoist false or minimal or disabled read/edit retains ordinary edit schema; prefixed edit does not become a hashline slot.
conditional_variants.disabled_tools: Existing adapter filters are exact names after gates, so disabling a currently absent name has no additional effect. New canonical migration should use canonical names and must not perpetuate aliases.
conditional_variants.bash_gate: The enabled flag is derived from top-level bash false/true/object, legacy experimental.bash flags or surface default; rewrite/compress/host_fallback/subagent_background do not independently change registration.
